name: v33_intangible_margin_event_no_reversal

expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_intan / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_sentiment_score, 60), industry)
notes: Rescue of akd7vaO9 with close/open removed; strict corr gate versus mL8j98w9 and MPpGzqwr.

expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_30_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)

expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(max_adj_net_income_quarterly_estimate - min_adj_net_income_quarterly_estimate) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(num_adj_net_income_est, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_sentiment_score, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_30_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)

expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_sentiment_score, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_vol_10 - pcr_vol_180, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 60), industry)
